description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Amendments to the Export Regulations published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1627/2 of 09.11.2009 and 1518/4 of 08.10.2007 and revoked the Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1912/31 of 30.04.2015
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Imports and Export (Control) Act, amending export control regulations and license fees for specific goods (Areca nuts). This falls under legal/regulatory matters as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks for import/export control.
